nodes.name: Sklearn Cluster Agglomerative Public API Shell
nodes.description: High-level AgglomerativeClustering and FeatureAgglomeration selection, linkage-boundary, fit/transform-payload, and fitted hierarchy-state atoms above Ward/linkage tree construction, SciPy hierarchy, compiled helpers, and feature pooling.

nodes.name: agglomerative_public_estimator_catalog
nodes.description: Expose public agglomerative estimator names useful for framework-level clustering selection.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom returns a fixed estimator-name tuple and does not inspect data.

nodes.name: agglomerative_public_estimator_axis
nodes.description: Return whether a public agglomerative estimator clusters samples or features.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom performs a constant-time branch over fixed estimator names.

nodes.name: agglomerative_public_linkage_boundary
nodes.description: Return the Ward or linkage tree-construction boundary selected by a public agglomerative estimator.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom performs a constant-time branch over fixed linkage labels.

nodes.name: agglomerative_public_estimator_methods
nodes.description: Expose public methods useful for high-level agglomerative routing.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom returns a fixed public-method tuple for each covered estimator.

nodes.name: agglomerative_public_fit_method_payload
nodes.description: Expose a public agglomerative fit payload for finite dense inputs without constructing a hierarchy.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom validates dense fit inputs and packages references without tree construction.

nodes.name: feature_agglomeration_transform_payload
nodes.description: Expose a public FeatureAgglomeration transform payload without pooling feature groups.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom validates dense transform input and packages references, leaving feature pooling to sklearn.

nodes.name: agglomerative_public_fit_return_self
nodes.description: Return the fitted public agglomerative estimator object from the public fit shell.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom checks fitted marker attributes and returns the same estimator object.

nodes.name: agglomerative_public_fitted_state_summary
nodes.description: Expose fitted children, labels, cluster, leaf, component, feature, linkage, and distance metadata after deferred tree construction.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom exposes shape and count metadata from already-fitted arrays without traversing the hierarchy.

metadata.remediation_case: Case 3 and Case 4 public agglomerative hierarchy shells over Ward/linkage tree construction, SciPy hierarchy, compiled helper, and feature-pooling boundaries
limitations: Ward distances, linkage tree construction, SciPy hierarchy calls, compiled _hierarchical helpers, early-cut labeling, feature pooling, inverse transform, and estimator method execution remain delegated behavior.
The shell models finite dense public API routing and compact fitted hierarchy-state packaging, not hierarchical clustering algorithm execution.
